item.description: Nine ​additional ​children have been reunited with ​their ‌families ⁠amid ‌the war ⁠in Ukraine, bringing the ​total to ‌43 amid an ‌effort ​led by US first lady Melania ​Trump, ​the ​White House ​said on Wednesday.

item.title: War in the Middle East: Surge of violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The four Israeli soldiers stepped out of their car in the occupied West Bank, their faces masked, their uniforms unmarked and automatic weapons strapped across their shoulders. They had entered a Palestinian olive grove but, little did they expect, the person there planning to tell them to leave could have once been issuing them orders.

item.description: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is taking bold steps to curb rampant oil smuggling, moves that the US has praised but that risk putting him at odds with Iraq's Kurds and neighbouring Iran.

item.title: What are the main issues driving Spain's national election ?
item.description: Spain will elect a new government on Sunday in a snap election that could unseat Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The progressive leader has governed Spain for 8 years, presiding over several crises, years of economic expansion and immigration-led population growth. No issue, however, has affected Spaniards during this time as much as unaffordable housing.
